findings.summary: Front-desk appointment cards render PIS name as-is
SMS reminders include the PIS display name in the message body

evidence.quote: Riverbend Health reminder: appointment for ${patient.name} on

hypothesized_consumers.hypothesis: Front-desk verbal identity confirmation uses the name shown on the appointment card; a given/family reorder may confuse check-in for compound surnames.
hypothesized_consumers.evidence_trail: README states dob is shown for verbal confirmation and name is rendered as-is from PIS.
hypothesized_consumers.confirm_by: Ask Access & Scheduling whether check-in scripts read the card name or ask the patient to state it first.

flags.summary: Re-read a reminder SMS for a multi-part surname after given[]/family composition.
flags.tied_to_finding: SMS reminders include the PIS display name in the message body

flags.summary: Tell front desk the appointment-card name format may change with PIS v3.
flags.tied_to_finding: Front-desk appointment cards render PIS name as-is

rating_rationale: People see name on cards and in SMS, but Cadence never shows ssn and there is no documented script that depends on the exact 'Last, First' string.
rating_would_change_if: A runbook quoted a required 'Last, First' format for check-in, or reminders were shown to include more of the PIS payload.
